subject.title: fix(agy): suppress tool use and file links in print-mode summaries

question: Is the small reduction in maximum accepted no-tools Antigravity prompt size acceptable in exchange for suppressing tool narration and local file links?
rationale: The patch safely checks the final sent prompt, but an edge-case prompt that previously fit may now exceed Antigravity’s argv limit; accepting that user-visible compatibility tradeoff is a repository-owner decision.

options.title: Merge the focused workaround
options.body: Accept the small argv-budget reduction because the patch fixes reproduced output contamination, fails oversized inputs explicitly, and preserves tool-enabled calls.

options.title: Request a shorter instruction
options.body: Reduce the suffix wording before merge to recover some prompt capacity while preserving the no-tools and no-file-links intent.

recommendation.title: Merge the focused workaround
recommendation.body: Accept the small argv-budget reduction because the patch fixes reproduced output contamination, fails oversized inputs explicitly, and preserves tool-enabled calls.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, `steipete` is the best available owner for the compatibility-versus-output-quality tradeoff.
